summary: The APES Times channel page now opens at /apes-times instead of redirecting to an older imported story with the same name.
detailed_changes: Redirects carried over from Ghost no longer take priority over a public channel page or its RSS feed, so /apes-times shows the APES Times channel (#542).
If a channel's newsletter is archived, its old Ghost redirect applies again.
affected_areas: Public impact: /apes-times opens the channel page
